title: The Multiverse
blurb: Eternal inflation, many-worlds and the string landscape are three different ideas, not one. See precisely why no experiment separates them.

sources.cite: Linde 1983, Phys. Lett. B 129, 177; Vilenkin 1983, PRD 27, 2848

open: None of the three is currently testable. This is the entire point of the page and of its badge.
The bubble geometry is schematic: nucleation rate, bubble wall dynamics and the true measure problem are not modelled.
The one real observational test — a CMB bubble-collision signature — has been performed and found nothing.
